rationale: Five-step: requirement = RFC-0052 (Signed Off) staged review REPLACES code+test review; the verifier not knowing staged-review is the defect, not the design. staged-beside-code-test deletes the feature's value (doubles reviewer cost); staged-inert-until-follow-up ships dark code. Class (a): applying what a signed-off RFC already permits, with a tightening condition — the verifier counts a staged-review synthesize leaf toward correctness (kind two) and code+test (kind three) ONLY when the leaf is Merkle-proved in the same envelope AND the staged plan/stage leaves show the baseline checklist ran; security-reviewer requirements unchanged. Needs a verifier test with a staged leaf set and a negative test (staged leaf without plan leaves is rejected).
